idea_name: Customer sign-off and attributable approval workspace
idea_description: A lightweight approval and audit-trail workspace for service teams that need to collect customer sign-off, preserve attributable approval history and reduce disputes.
target_customer: Service teams that deliver work to customers
target_region: United States and global English-speaking markets

assumptions.buyer: Service operations leaders, agency owners, and client-delivery leaders
assumptions.endUser: Project managers, account managers, and service-delivery staff who request and track customer approval
assumptions.problem: Customer approvals are scattered or ambiguous, leaving service teams without attributable proof and exposed to disputes
assumptions.workflow: Requesting, collecting, recording, and retrieving customer approval or sign-off on service deliverables
assumptions.expectedOutcome: Faster customer sign-off, preserved attributable approval history, and fewer delivery or billing disputes
assumptions.directCompetitorCategory: Client approval, online proofing, and customer sign-off audit-trail software
